hero.title: AL ENAYA for Access Care
hero.subtitle: Towards a Fully Inclusive Society
hero.description: We deliver comprehensive universal accessibility solutions for people with disabilities across Saudi Arabia, meeting the highest national and international standards.

universal_access.title: What is Universal Access?
universal_access.description: Universal access is a comprehensive system of technical, architectural, and awareness solutions that guarantee the rights of people with disabilities to fully participate in daily life, enjoy equal opportunities, and integrate effectively in society.
universal_access.equal_desc: Ensuring every individual receives their full rights without discrimination
universal_access.integration_desc: Preparing environments to be inclusive and accessible for everyone
universal_access.quality_desc: Improving the daily living standards for people with disabilities

services_preview.title: Our Services
services_preview.subtitle: Comprehensive solutions for three disability types
services_preview.visual_desc: Complete solutions for the blind and visually impaired: tactile paths, Braille signage, voice guidance systems, and LED-lit corridors.
services_preview.motor_desc: Architectural environment upgrades ensuring full wheelchair access and mobility compliance with Saudi universal access codes.
services_preview.hearing_desc: LED light and vibration alert devices, visual sign-language displays for safety, evacuation, and facility navigation.

services.title: Our Full Services
services.subtitle: Specialized solutions for every disability type

visual.title: Visual Disability
visual.description: We provide a fully integrated system of solutions to ensure the independence and safety of blind and visually impaired individuals across various environments.
items: White/electronic cane with sensor alert systems
Talking directional signage boards
Braille-translated elevator buttons with voice floor announcer
Electronic voice control panel at entrances with Braille labels
Transparent Braille stickers for everyday tools and appliances
Tactile floor guidance paths for white cane users
Warning dots for navigation (white cane / foot detection)
Braille booklets and service guides for facilities
LED-lit corridors and rooms for low-vision individuals
Liquid level sensor devices for drinking and cooking vessels
Emergency corridor equipment for evacuating the visually impaired
Enforcement of disability rights laws with penalties for violators

motor.title: Motor Disability
motor.description: Upgrading architectural environments to meet approved universal access codes, ensuring full freedom of movement for wheelchair users and those with mobility disabilities.
items: Safe ramps (street to sidewalk to upper level) with railings per approved standards
Universal access code compliance: spaces, heights, accessories, switch and socket heights
Accessible ablution areas and bathrooms per universal access specs (toilet chair, sink, mixer, accessories)
Interior signage for disability-specific amenities (prayer room, ablution area, restrooms)
Emergency exits with evacuation equipment and wheelchair ramps
Non-slip exterior flooring
Corridors adapted for individuals with balance impairments

hearing.title: Hearing Disability
hearing.description: Advanced alert devices and systems combining vibration and light to ensure the safety and communication of deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals.
items: Pocket or pillow vibrating alert devices
LED light alert devices
Hearing-disability smoke detectors
Dual alert via vibration and light simultaneously
Cards, signage, and visual sign-language displays showing: facility service guide, evacuation plan, first aid info

hotels.title: Hotel & Tourism Resort Services
hotels.subtitle: Complete solutions per Ministry of Tourism requirements
hotels.description: We provide specialized services for hotels and tourism resorts to ensure full compliance with universal accessibility standards as required by the Saudi Ministry of Tourism.
hotels.compliance: Solutions per approved Ministry of Tourism standards
hotels.hearing_card_desc: LED and vibration alert devices synced to all hotel sounds and bells; visual sign-language displays (audio + written) showing hotel services and evacuation plan.
hotels.motor_card_desc: Accessories, mobility requirements, and call systems for guests with motor disabilities, per universal access codes.
hotels.visual_card_desc: Redesign and translate printed materials and signage to Braille (Arabic & English); Braille elevator buttons (national manufacture); voice floor announcement system; tactile paths and warning dots.
